title: 覆盖率基线验证 (vitest --coverage frontend + backend)
description: 运行 vitest --coverage 获取 frontend (desktop/) 和 backend (src-ts/) 的实际行/函数/分支覆盖率数据，建立基线。当前覆盖率仅为估算值 (~68%)，需要精确数据驱动后续覆盖率改进优先级决策。
action: Run `npx vitest run --coverage` in both desktop/ and src-ts/ directories, capture line/function/branch/statement coverage numbers, write baseline report to .workflow/scratch/20260616-plan-test-coverage/coverage-baseline.json

criteria: coverage-baseline.json contains key "frontend" with numeric line, function, branch values
coverage-baseline.json contains key "backend" with numeric line, function, branch values
cd desktop && npx vitest run --coverage exits 0
cd src-ts && npx vitest run --coverage exits 0
convergence.verification: Run vitest --coverage in both directories, verify JSON baseline file exists with complete numeric coverage data for both frontend and backend
convergence.definition_of_done: Frontend 和 backend 均有精确覆盖率基线数据（line/function/branch/statement），数据已持久化到 coverage-baseline.json

files.change: Create JSON file with frontend and backend coverage metrics extracted from vitest --coverage output

implementation: Ensure @vitest/coverage-v8 is installed in both desktop/ and src-ts/ (check package.json)
Run `cd desktop && npx vitest run --coverage 2>&1` and capture output — extract coverage summary numbers (lines, functions, branches, statements)
Run `cd src-ts && npx vitest run --coverage 2>&1` and capture output — extract coverage summary numbers
Parse coverage output to extract numeric values per directory

Write coverage-baseline.json with structure: { "timestamp": "2026-06-16T...", "frontend": { "lines": N, "functions": N, "branches": N, "statements": N }, "backend": { "lines": N, "functions": N, "branches": N, "statements": N } }
If coverage run fails due to missing @vitest/coverage-v8, install it and re-run
Compare baseline against configured thresholds (desktop: lines 75, functions 70, branches 70; src-ts: lines 80, branches 70, functions 80) and note gaps

success_metrics: coverage-baseline.json has valid numeric coverage data
coverage numbers differ from estimated 68% (verify with actual data)

reference.pattern: vitest coverage-v8 provider with JSON/text reporters

rationale.chosen_approach: Run actual coverage measurement as the final task after all tests are added, so baseline reflects post-remediation coverage. This drives future prioritization.
decision_factors: Current ~68% coverage is estimated, not measured — need exact numbers
Coverage thresholds are configured (desktop: 75/70/70/75, src-ts: 80/70/80/80) but may not be met
Post-remediation baseline enables gap analysis for future iterations
Coverage data enables evidence-based prioritization of R-004 (E2E) scope
rationale.tradeoffs: Running coverage as a separate task adds overhead, but ensures baseline is measured after Wave 1+2 tests are in place — measuring before remediation would give misleading numbers

risks: vitest --coverage may time out or OOM on large codebase — may need --pool=forks or increased timeout
Coverage output format may vary between vitest versions — need to parse text summary carefully
Some test files may fail under coverage mode (different timing/async behavior) — fix failures before capturing baseline
